items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: This guy's Coco Hino. Whatever happened to him? ... He must be dead.

ctx.x: You can move fast enough. But when somebody brings you up there and say, you remember Johnny Bauer. Oh, he throws his arm around him.

He puts that whip and kisses all of him. He's a jig, you know? He's a jig. Yeah, he's got colored in. Yeah. Yeah, he's a jig. Yeah, Gilbert, yeah. He doesn't need to be a fool around. What about this guy? Did he have to jump over the gutter? No, he must say something. This guy's Coco Hino. Whatever happened to him?
Do you remember Coco Hino? Yeah, yeah. Guitar player, yeah. Played tremendous guitar. Yeah. We had a fellow with us, though.
